funFacts: Giraffe spots are like human fingerprints — unique to each individual.
A giraffe's tongue is 45–50 cm long and dark blue-black.
They have the same number of neck vertebrae as humans — 7.
Giraffes sleep only 30 minutes to 2 hours per day.
